text: make a website for my aunt's flower shop called Petal & Stem in Jaipur. people should see the bouquets with prices, order one for delivery, and know the shop timings and where it is

@Requester Thanks, this is a clear start. I need a few shop details before I can plan the site.
1. Please send the list of bouquets with the name and price (in rupees) of each. Do you also have photos of them?
2. What are the shop's opening days and hours, the full address, and the phone number? A Google Maps link is a bonus if you have one.
3. How should a customer place an order on the site?
   Option 1: A form that sends the order as a WhatsApp message to the shop (needs the shop's WhatsApp number, quick to build)
   Option 2: A form that sends the order by email (needs the shop's email address, quick to build)
   Option 3: A form plus online payment (needs a payment account and takes noticeably longer)
4. Besides bouquets with prices, ordering, timings and location, I think visitors will also want to know which parts of Jaipur you deliver to, the delivery charge, and whether same-day delivery is possible. Should I include these? Please give me the details or tell me to leave any out.
Paused: Identity is waiting on the Requester (J2.a: not enough information to work yet). Site v0 is in the preview. Answer Identity's question above to continue.

Address: 12 MI Road, near Panch Batti, Jaipur 302001. Phone: +91 141 400 5566.
Timings: 9am to 8pm, Monday to Saturday. Closed on Sunday.
Bouquets: Red rose dozen ₹899, Sunflower bunch ₹699, Mixed seasonal ₹999, White lilies ₹1,199, Orchid box ₹1,499.
Delivery: same day inside Jaipur if ordered before 4pm, ₹99 delivery charge. Orders go to WhatsApp +91 98290 11223, pay on delivery.
Photos: not yet, leave empty spots for now.
@Adaptation Charter recorded for Petal & Stem, a Jaipur florist site with bouquets and prices, a WhatsApp order form, delivery terms, timings and location. Photos are empty spots for now.
@Adaptation Charter valid: statement present, 8 checkable done-when items. Work can start.

@Priority Following playbook P-20261007-182425 (cafe), trimmed to this brief: scaffold first with the viewport meta tag, then the core sections. Four workflows, 70 of 100 budget, leaving 30 for fixes.

proposal.name: Scaffold and styling
proposal.goal_gap: No page exists yet, so the shop name and Jaipur are not shown.
proposal.expected_outcome: One HTML file with a viewport meta tag, a mobile-first style guide, and a header and intro showing Petal & Stem and Jaipur.
proposal.completion_check: The page shows Petal & Stem and Jaipur, has a viewport meta tag, and has no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px.

proposal.name: Bouquets and prices
proposal.goal_gap: Visitors cannot see the bouquets or their prices.
proposal.expected_outcome: A section listing exactly the five bouquets with prices as given, each with an empty image placeholder.
proposal.completion_check: Exactly five bouquets appear with prices ₹899, ₹699, ₹999, ₹1,199 and ₹1,499, each with an empty image placeholder.

proposal.name: WhatsApp order form
proposal.goal_gap: Visitors cannot place a delivery order.
proposal.expected_outcome: A form with a bouquet picker, name, phone and delivery address, whose submit opens WhatsApp to +91 98290 11223 with the details filled in.
proposal.completion_check: Submitting the form with valid values opens a wa.me link for 919829011223 whose message contains the chosen bouquet, name, phone and address, with no JavaScript errors.

proposal.name: Delivery, timings and location
proposal.goal_gap: Visitors cannot see delivery terms, shop hours, or how to find and call the shop.
proposal.expected_outcome: A delivery terms section and a visit-us section with timings, address, tap-to-call phone and a map link.
proposal.completion_check: The page states same day delivery inside Jaipur before 4pm, a ₹99 charge and pay on delivery; shows 9am to 8pm Monday to Saturday and closed Sunday; shows 12 MI Road, near Panch Batti, Jaipur 302001; has a tel:+911414005566 link and a working map link; and has no broken in-page links.

playbook_changes: Dropped Animations, Stories and the separate Viewport fix (the viewport tag is built into the scaffold), and split Core sections into bouquets, order form and info.
